title: THE STASH HOVER KEEPS EVERY BOX THE SAME SIZE
why: his order 10-27: mousing over different items in the stash changes the size of one of the sub menus, so the grids jump; the item line under the grids was hidden when idle and as tall as the hovered item had rows
now: the item line under the stash grids is one fixed size box, hover or not: the backpack, hotbar, gun keys and stash grid no longer move when the mouse crosses items
